goals: Verify the API successfully deletes a single file from a workshop and correctly updates the database and file storage
Verify the API successfully deletes multiple files from a workshop simultaneously and correctly updates the database and file storage
activities: Create two test files and add them to the workshop in MongoDB
Send a DELETE request to the API to remove one file from the workshop
Parse the API response and remove the file from the local workshop object
Verify the response status code is 200 and validate the response headers and body
Verify the workshop data in the database
Verify the deleted file is removed from storage while the non-deleted file remains
Create two test files and add them to the second workshop in MongoDB
Send a DELETE request to the API to remove multiple files from the workshop
Parse the API response and remove the files from the local workshop object
Verify the response status code is 200 and validate the response headers and body
Verify the second workshop data in the database
Verify both deleted files are removed from storage
Clean workshop test data and server test files
